title: Dura-Europos Church
scope: An interpretation of the Dura-Europos Christian Building in its later third-century worship phase, with open court, flat earthen roofs, assembly hall, baptistery and roof stair on the surveyed M8-A site.
limitations: The model reconstructs the worship phase around 250 CE on the modern surveyed coordinates. Roof edges, secondary doors, exterior paint, partition locations without published dimensions and reconstructed plaster details are approximate.

The basin and canopy follow Pearson’s recorded section. The painted plaster is represented by muted tonal modeling without reproducing the complete mural cycle. Nearby buildings, city walls and the later embankment are outside the selected footprint.
